# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Feather to be a welcoming project for everyone, whatever their experience, background or identity.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new.
- Keep feedback about code and ideas, not about people.
- Search existing issues before opening a new one.

## Not allowed

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks.
- Sharing or asking for leaked, stolen or company-owned signing certificates.
- Posting pirated apps or links to them.
- Spam or self-promotion unrelated to Feather.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close issues, or block users who break these rules. To report a problem, open an issue or contact the maintainers at https://github.com/NuzProjects.

This code of conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
